quantizer.profile_selector: one complete byte in every 64-byte role-component header

families.literal4: two literal bits per ordered label

rm1_plus_exceptions.base: one RM(1,m) affine Boolean function per Gray bitplane and 2^m block
rm1_plus_exceptions.larger_search: bounded no-exception shortlist followed by exact exception optimization; no global-negative authority

gf2_rank_plus_exceptions.base: one U*V mod 2 factor product per Gray bitplane

romdd_plus_exceptions.base: bounded reduced ordered mixed-radix decision diagram over exact role dimensions

exception_packet.replacement_bits: ceil(log2(3^e)) base-3 rank among labels other than the base
exception_packet.physical_alignment: RM overlays are optimized with per-block byte alignment; GF2 and ROMDD overlays are optimized with whole-family-payload byte alignment
exception_packet.optimization: exact best alternatives and exact best e-position set for every evaluated base object

coordinate_domain.role_identity: separate physical component packet, not a padded two-bit truth-table variable

controls.generation: independent Gaussian values matched to each immutable source quantization block binary64 mean and centered energy
controls.rerun: profile selection, BF16 scale fit, every label-flexible family search, exception packing, byte/page framing, decode, and global model selection
